endpoint products.list {
  route: GET "/products"
  output: [Product]
}

endpoint products.get {
  route: GET "/products/[id]"
  output: Product
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint products.create {
  route: POST "/products"
  input: { name: string(max 120), price_cents: int(min 0), stock: int(min 0) }
  output: Product
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint products.update {
  route: PATCH "/products/[id]"
  input: { name: string(max 120), price_cents: int(min 0), stock: int(min 0) } (all optional)
  output: Product
  errors: not_found, invalid_input
}

endpoint products.delete {
  route: DELETE "/products/[id]"
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint customers.list {
  route: GET "/customers"
  output: [Customer]
}

endpoint customers.get {
  route: GET "/customers/[id]"
  output: Customer
  errors: not_found
}

endpoint customers.create {
  route: POST "/customers"
  input: { email: email, name: string(max 80) }
  output: Customer
  errors: invalid_input
}

endpoint orders.list {
  route: GET "/orders"
  output: [Order]
}

endpoint orders.get {
  route: GET "/orders/[id]"
  output: Order
  errors: not_found
}
